beats.en: The word per cent comes from the Latin per centum, meaning by the hundred, and the symbol % means out of 100. To change a fraction to a percentage we make an equivalent fraction with denominator 100: 3/4 = 75/100 = 75%.
beats.speakEn: The word per cent comes from the Latin per centum, meaning by the hundred, and the symbol % means out of 100. To change a fraction to a percentage we make an equivalent fraction with denominator 100: 3/4  equals  75/100  equals  75%.
